info.name: Scraper Module (Supreme Court Hearing Tracking)
info.description:
LAW ERP — Scraper module: Nepal Supreme Court cause-list ingestion, matching, and weekly CSV export.

Base path: /api/v1. Server port: 6969 (dev). Auth: Bearer JWT; scrape/export are FIRM_ADMIN only, hearing-status is FIRM_ADMIN / ADVOCATE / PARALEGAL.

Workflow:
1. Login → copy accessToken into the {{token}} variable.
2. (Optional, backfill) POST /scraper/admin/scrape?courtId=39&mode=daily&date=<BS> — pulls that date's WHOLE court list into scraper_daily_hearings.
   mode=weekly pulls the Sun-Fri window into scraper_weekly_hearings.
3. GET /cases/{caseNoInternal}/hearing-status — read from OUR DB (no live scrape). Optional ?date= (BS) filters to one day.
4. POST /scraper/admin/export — regenerates the previous Mon-Sun week's CSV snapshot.

Conventions: responses are { "success", "responseCode", "message", "data" }. Date params are Bikram Sambat yyyy-mm-dd (e.g. 2083-05-01). caseNo is the court-scoped INTERNAL form (39-081-32030), not the display form (081-C4-3827).

request.description: Login as an internal user. If MFA is enabled the response is status=MFA_REQUIRED with an mfaToken — call /auth/mfa/validate with { data: { mfaToken, totpCode } } to finish. On SUCCESS, copy data.accessToken into the {{token}} collection variable (the curl examples use it as Bearer).

item.name: All hearings for a case (upcoming + history)

request.description: DB only — never scrapes live. Returns upcoming + history for the court-scoped internal case number, with judge, subject, outcome and source.

item.name: Hearing status filtered to one BS date

request.description: Same read path, filtered to one BS date — answers 'was this case on the list on that day?'. The date must have been scraped first (admin scrape) for data to exist.

item.name: Scrape daily list for a court + date

request.description: FIRM_ADMIN. Hits the court site live for one court on one BS date and stores the ENTIRE list into scraper_daily_hearings (upsert). rows=0 means the site has no list for that date (not published yet).

item.name: Scrape weekly list for a court

request.description: FIRM_ADMIN. Pulls the Sun-Fri weekly window for the court into scraper_weekly_hearings. date is ignored in weekly mode.
FIRM_ADMIN. Writes (overwrites) the previous completed Mon-Sun window to <export-dir>/week-<monday>_<sunday>.csv and returns the absolute file path.
